settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.subheading: Everything you need to know about Zavelyn BotanaRoots Organic Batana Oil.

settings.question: How do I apply Zavelyn BotanaRoots for best results?
settings.answer: Warm a few drops between your palms and gently massage into your scalp in circular motions for 3–5 minutes. Leave on for at least 30 minutes, or overnight as an intensive scalp treatment before washing.

settings.question: How soon will I see visible results?
settings.answer: Most customers report a reduction in shedding within 10-14 days. Visible new baby hair growth and thickening of sparse areas typically appears between 4 to 8 weeks of daily use.

settings.question: Can I use this on color-treated, bleached, or chemically straightened hair?
settings.answer: Yes! Zavelyn BotanaRoots™ is 100% natural, sulfate-free, and color-safe. It actually helps repair damage caused by bleaching and hot styling tools.

settings.question: Is it suitable for both men and women?
settings.answer: Absolutely. BotanaRoots™ is universally effective for all hair types (Type 1 straight to Type 4 coily) and works equally well on receding men's hairlines and thinning women's crowns.

settings.question: Is it 100% pure raw batana oil with no added chemicals?
settings.answer: Yes. Our Batana Oil is sustainably wild-harvested in La Mosquitia, Honduras, following centuries-old artisanal roasting methods. It contains zero mineral oils, parabens, sulfates, silicones, or synthetic fragrances.
